title: WarHub Barcode Index
description: Every barcode published by this release, in either catalog, mapped to the records that carry it. Scan a barcode, look the string up as a key, get back the product record(s) and/or paint record(s) it belongs to. A key whose entries name BOTH catalogs is the same physical thing published twice -- once as a retail SKU, once as a colour; counts.crossCatalog is how many of those there are.

counts.description: barcodes (distinct, both catalogs), productBarcodes, paintBarcodes, crossCatalog (held by both), references (barcode/record pairs).

barcodes.description: The barcode string exactly as published on the records -- no normalization is applied here that the rest of the pipeline does not already do.

ref.description: One record carrying the barcode. More than one entry from the SAME catalog means two records claim it; this document reports that, it does not adjudicate it.

id.description: The record's id in its catalog: manufacturer/code for products, brand-slug/paint-slug for paints. A paint id is derived from the paint's own identity, so it does not move when unrelated records are added; the link is still published per build rather than left to be assumed, because whether a name collides inside its brand -- and so whether its id is bare or qualified -- is not visible from any single record.
